ios.desc:
Crack the code, balance equations, and train your brain!

MathHeist is the ultimate collection of number puzzles, crossmath grids, and rapid mental arithmetic drills designed to keep your mind sharp. Whether you want a relaxing logic session or an intense speed challenge, MathHeist delivers hundreds of handcrafted stages, fully playable offline.

FOUR EXCITING GAME MODES IN ONE APP

1. CROSSMATH AND MATH CROSSWORDS
Deduce your way through intersecting number grids. Fill in the blanks with addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division to balance every row and column simultaneously. It is the perfect blend of classic crosswords and Sudoku.

2. TENS: NUMBER MATCH AND SUM PUZZLE
Clear the board by tapping pairs of adjacent numbers that add up to 10. Plan your clearing paths, trigger cascading combo chains, and master tactile tile matching.

3. SPEED MATH AND ARITHMETIC DRILLS
Race against the countdown timer through 10 progressive difficulty chapters. Test your calculation speed across addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Sharpen your times tables, boost accuracy gates, and build lightning fast mental math reflexes.

4. 5-MINUTE DAILY BRAIN WORKOUT
Build a rewarding mental habit every single day. Complete daily math challenges, protect your streak, unlock bonus chests, and track your cognitive growth over time.

KEY FEATURES

* 100% Offline Play: No internet or Wi-Fi needed. Enjoy seamless puzzling on subways, flights, or off the grid.
* 1,000+ Crafted Levels: Progress from gentle beginner warmups to master Grandmaster brain busters.
* Adaptive Chapter Journey: 10 structured difficulty tiers that scale naturally as your math skills level up.
* Global Leaderboards: Earn XP, rise through the Heist ranks, and see how your speed compares worldwide.
* Clean Modern Design: High-contrast visuals, smooth haptic feedback, and themes crafted for focus and eye comfort.
* For All Ages: Perfect for adults seeking cognitive fitness, students sharpening multiplication tables, or anyone who loves logic puzzles.

Keep your brain active, improve mental agility, and pull off the ultimate MathHeist!

Download free today and start solving!
